verdict.rationale: Polar's docs describe a quick-start path: official typed TypeScript and Python SDKs, framework adapters billed as making checkouts and webhooks "dead simple", and a "6 lines of code" claim. They also cover three checkout surfaces (no-code links, embed, Session API), an isolated sandbox with test cards, SDK webhook validation helpers, and a `polar listen` CLI for local webhook testing. That covers the core of a same-day integration, but it rests entirely on vendor claims. Missing for 10: actual copy-paste code samples shown in the evidence, documented SDK coverage beyond TypeScript and Python, and independent or hands-on confirmation of under-a-day integration time.
